info.name: List All Webhooks Belonging to a Specific Org.

params.name: ids
params.description: A filter on the data based on this comma-separated list of webhook IDs. Example: `ids=49412323223,49412329928`

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit for how many objects will be in the response. Default and max for this value is 512 objects.

params.name: after
params.description: If specified, this should be the endCursor value from the previous page of results. When present, this request will return the next page of results that occur immediately after the previous page of results.

items.docs: List all webhooks belonging to a specific org. Rate limit: 5 requests/sec (learn more about rate limits here). This means that any fields included in the patch request will _overwrite_ fields which exist on the target resource.
